tools.name: style_builder_tool
tools.description:
Generate Mapbox style JSON for creating new styles or updating existing ones.

The tool intelligently resolves layer types and filter properties using Streets v8 data.
You don't need exact layer names - the tool automatically finds the correct layer based on your filters.

BASE STYLES:
• standard: ALWAYS THE DEFAULT - Modern Mapbox Standard with best performance
• Classic styles: streets-v12/light-v11/dark-v11/satellite-v9/outdoors-v12/satellite-streets-v12/navigation-day-v1/navigation-night-v1
  Only use Classic when user explicitly says "create a classic style" or working with existing Classic style

STANDARD STYLE CONFIG:
Use standard_config to customize the basemap:
• Theme: default/faded/monochrome
• Light: day/night/dawn/dusk
• Show/hide: labels, roads, 3D buildings
• Colors: water, roads, parks, etc.

LAYER ORDERING:
• Layers are rendered in order - last layer in the array appears visually on top
• The 'slot' parameter is OPTIONAL - by default, layer order in the array determines visibility
• For Standard style, you can optionally use 'slot' to control placement:
  - No slot (default): Above all existing layers in the style
  - 'top': Behind Place and Transit labels
  - 'middle': Between basemap and labels
  - 'bottom': Below most basemap features

LAYER RENDERING:
• render_type controls HOW to visualize the layer (line, fill, symbol, etc.)
• Most important: Use render_type:"line" for outlines/borders even on polygon features
• Default "auto" picks based on geometry, but override for specific effects:
  - Building outlines → render_type:"line" (not fill!)
  - Solid buildings → render_type:"fill" or "fill-extrusion" (3D)
  - Road lines → render_type:"line" (auto works too)
  - POI dots → render_type:"circle"
  - Labels → render_type:"symbol"

LAYER ACTIONS:
• color: Apply a specific color
• highlight: Make prominent
• hide: Remove from view
• show: Display with defaults

AUTO-DETECTION:
The tool automatically finds the correct layer from your filter_properties.
Examples:
• { class: 'park' } → finds 'landuse' layer
• { type: 'wetland' } → finds 'landuse_overlay' layer
• { maki: 'restaurant' } → finds 'poi_label' layer
• { toll: true } → finds 'road' layer
• { admin_level: 0 } → finds 'admin' layer (for country boundaries)
• { admin_level: 1 } → finds 'admin' layer (for state/province boundaries)

IMPORTANT LAYER NAMES:
• Use "admin" for all boundaries (countries, states, etc.)
• Use "building" (singular, not "buildings")
• Use "road" for all streets, highways, paths

If a layer type is not recognized, the tool will provide helpful suggestions showing:
• All available source layers from Streets v8
• Which fields are available in each layer
• Examples of how to properly specify layers and filters

base_style.description: Base style template. ALWAYS use "standard" as the default for all new styles. Standard style provides the best performance and modern features. Only use Classic styles (streets/light/dark/satellite/outdoors/navigation) when explicitly requested with "create a classic style" or when working with an existing Classic style.

render_type.description:
How to render this layer visually. Default "auto" chooses based on geometry type.
Override to achieve specific visual effects:
• "line" - For outlines, borders, strokes (e.g., building outlines, road borders)
• "fill" - For solid filled areas (e.g., solid color buildings, water bodies)
• "fill-extrusion" - For 3D extrusions (e.g., 3D buildings)
• "symbol" - For text labels or icons
• "circle" - For dot visualization (e.g., POI dots, data points)
• "heatmap" - For density maps (points only)
IMPORTANT: Use "line" for outlines even on polygon features like buildings.

action.description: What to do with this layer

color.description: Color value if action is "color" or "highlight"

width.description: Width for line layers or outline thickness

filter_properties.description: Filter by specific properties. Examples: { class: "motorway" } for only motorways, { class: ["motorway", "trunk"] } for multiple road types, { structure: "bridge" } for only bridges, { admin_level: 0, disputed: "false" } for undisputed country boundaries

min_zoom.description: Minimum zoom level for zoom-based styling

max_zoom.description: Maximum zoom level for zoom-based styling

property_based.description: Feature property to base styling on (e.g., "class", "type")

property_values.description: Map of property values to styles

expression.description: Custom Mapbox expression for advanced styling

slot.description: Layer slot for Mapbox Standard styles. Controls layer stacking order. Bottom: below most map features, Middle: between base and labels, Top: above all base map features (default)

layers.description: Layer configurations based on the mapbox-style-layers resource

standard_config.description: Configuration for the base Mapbox Standard style. These properties customize the underlying Standard style features - you can still add your own custom layers on top using the layers parameter. The Standard style provides a rich basemap that you can configure and enhance with additional layers.

showPedestrianRoads.description: Show/hide the base pedestrian roads and paths from the Standard style

showPlaceLabels.description: Show/hide the base place label layers from the Standard style

showPointOfInterestLabels.description: Show/hide the base POI icons and text from the Standard style

showRoadLabels.description: Show/hide the base road labels and shields from the Standard style

showTransitLabels.description: Show/hide the base transit icons and text from the Standard style

show3dObjects.description: Show/hide the base 3D objects like buildings and landmarks from the Standard style

showLandmarkIcons.description: Show/hide the base landmark icons from the Standard style

showLandmarkIconLabels.description: Show/hide the base landmark icon labels from the Standard style

showAdminBoundaries.description: Show/hide the base administrative boundaries from the Standard style

showRoadsAndTransit.description: Show/hide the base roads and transit networks from the Standard style (Standard-Satellite)

theme.description: Theme for the base Standard style layers

theme-data.description: Custom color theme for the base style via Base64 LUT image

lightPreset.description: Time-of-day lighting for the base Standard style

font.description: Font family for the base Standard style text

colorModePointOfInterestLabels.description: Color mode for the base POI labels

backgroundPointOfInterestLabels.description: Background style for the base POI labels

densityPointOfInterestLabels.description: Density of base POI labels (1-5, default 3)

colorPlaceLabels.description: Override color for the base place labels in Standard style

colorRoadLabels.description: Override color for the base road labels in Standard style

colorGreenspace.description: Override color for the base greenspace areas in Standard style

colorWater.description: Override color for the base water features in Standard style

colorAdminBoundaries.description: Override color for the base administrative boundaries in Standard style

colorPointOfInterestLabels.description: Override color for the base POI labels in Standard style

colorMotorways.description: Override color for the base motorways/highways in Standard style

colorTrunks.description: Override color for the base trunk roads in Standard style

colorRoads.description: Override color for the base regular roads in Standard style

colorBuildingHighlight.description: Override color for the base highlighted buildings in Standard style

colorBuildingSelect.description: Override color for the base selected buildings in Standard style

colorPlaceLabelHighlight.description: Override color for the base highlighted place labels in Standard style

colorPlaceLabelSelect.description: Override color for the base selected place labels in Standard style

tools.name: geojson_preview_tool
tools.description: Generate a geojson.io URL to visualize GeoJSON data. Returns only the URL link.

geojson.description: GeoJSON data as a JSON string (e.g., {"type": "Point", "coordinates": [-122.4194, 37.7749]})

tools.name: check_color_contrast_tool
tools.description: Checks color contrast ratios between foreground and background colors for WCAG 2.1 accessibility compliance

foregroundColor.description: Foreground color (text color) in any CSS format (hex, rgb, rgba, named colors)

backgroundColor.description: Background color in any CSS format (hex, rgb, rgba, named colors)

level.description: WCAG conformance level to check against (default: AA)

fontSize.description: Font size category: normal (<18pt or <14pt bold) or large (≥18pt or ≥14pt bold)

tools.name: compare_styles_tool
tools.description: Compares two Mapbox styles and reports differences in structure, layers, sources, and properties

styleA.description: First Mapbox style (JSON string or style object)

styleB.description: Second Mapbox style (JSON string or style object)

ignoreMetadata.description: Ignore metadata fields like id, owner, created, modified

tools.name: optimize_style_tool
tools.description: Optimizes Mapbox styles by removing unused sources, duplicate layers, and simplifying expressions

style.description: Mapbox style to optimize (JSON string or style object)

optimizations.description: Specific optimizations to apply (if not specified, all optimizations are applied)

tools.name: style_comparison_tool
tools.description: Generate a comparison URL for comparing two Mapbox styles side-by-side

before.description: Mapbox style for the "before" side. Accepts: full style URL (mapbox://styles/username/styleId), username/styleId format, or just styleId if using your own styles

after.description: Mapbox style for the "after" side. Accepts: full style URL (mapbox://styles/username/styleId), username/styleId format, or just styleId if using your own styles

accessToken.description: Mapbox public access token (required, must start with pk.* and have styles:read permission). Secret tokens (sk.*) cannot be used as they cannot be exposed in browser URLs. Please use a public token or create one with styles:read permission.

zoom.description: Initial zoom level for the map view (0-22). If provided along with latitude and longitude, sets the initial map position.

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate for the initial map center (-90 to 90). Must be provided together with longitude and zoom.

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate for the initial map center (-180 to 180). Must be provided together with latitude and zoom.

tools.name: create_token_tool
tools.description: Create a new Mapbox public access token with specified scopes and optional URL restrictions.

scopes.description: Array of scopes/permissions for the public token. Valid scopes: styles:tiles, styles:read, fonts:read, datasets:read, vision:read.

allowedUrls.description: Optional array of URLs where the token can be used (max 100)

expires.description: Optional expiration time in ISO 8601 format (maximum 1 hour in the future)

tools.name: list_tokens_tool
tools.description: List Mapbox access tokens for the authenticated user with optional filtering and pagination. Returns metadata for all tokens (public and secret), but the actual token value is only included for public tokens (secret token values are omitted for security). When using pagination, the "start" parameter must be obtained from the "next_start" field of the previous response (it is not a token ID)

default.description: Filter to show only the default public token

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return (1-100)

sortby.description: Sort tokens by created or modified timestamp

start.description: Token ID to start pagination from

tools.name: bounding_box_tool
tools.description: Calculates bounding box of given GeoJSON content, returns as [minX, minY, maxX, maxY]

geojson.description: GeoJSON content to calculate bounding box for

tools.name: country_bounding_box_tool
tools.description: Gets bounding box for a country by its ISO 3166-1 country code, returns as [minX, minY, maxX, maxY].

tools.name: coordinate_conversion_tool
tools.description: Converts coordinates between WGS84 (longitude/latitude) and EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator) coordinate systems

coordinates.description: Array of two numbers representing coordinates

from.description: Source coordinate system: wgs84 (longitude/latitude) or epsg3857 (Web Mercator)

to.description: Target coordinate system: wgs84 (longitude/latitude) or epsg3857 (Web Mercator)

tools.name: get_feedback_tool
tools.description: Get a single user feedback item from the Mapbox Feedback API by its unique ID. Use this tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific user-reported issue, suggestion, or feedback about map data, routing, or POI details. Requires user-feedback:read scope on the access token.

feedback_id.description: The unique identifier of the feedback item

format.description: Output format: "json_string" returns raw JSON data as a JSON string that can be parsed; "formatted_text" returns human-readable text. Both return as text content but json_string contains parseable JSON data while formatted_text is for display.

tools.name: list_feedback_tool
tools.description: List user feedback items from the Mapbox Feedback API with filtering, sorting, and pagination. Use this tool to access user-reported issues, suggestions, and feedback about map data, routing, and POI details. Supports comprehensive filtering by status, category, date ranges, trace IDs, and search text. Requires user-feedback:read scope on the access token.

feedback_ids.description: Filter by one or more feedback item IDs. At least one must match.

after.description: A cursor from a previous response. Use this to fetch the next page of results.

limit.description: The maximum number of feedback items to return (1-1000)

sort_by.description: The field to sort results by. Options: received_at (default), created_at, or updated_at

order.description: The sort direction: asc (ascending, default) or desc (descending)

status.description: Filter by one or more feedback statuses. Options: received, fixed, reviewed, out_of_scope

category.description: Filter by one or more feedback categories

search.description: A search phrase. Returns items where the feedback text contains the phrase.

trace_id.description: Filter by one or more trace_id values. At least one must match.

created_before.description: Return items created before the specified time. Use ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ

created_after.description: Return items created after the specified time. Use ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ

received_before.description: Return items received by Mapbox before the specified time. Use ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ

received_after.description: Return items received by Mapbox after the specified time. Use ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ

updated_before.description: Return items last updated before the specified time. Use ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ

updated_after.description: Return items last updated after the specified time. Use ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ

format.description: Output format: "json_string" returns raw JSON data as a JSON string that can be parsed; "formatted_text" returns human-readable text. Both return as text content but json_string contains parseable JSON data while formatted_text is for display.

tools.name: tilequery_tool
tools.description: Query vector and raster data from Mapbox tilesets at geographic coordinates

radius.description: Radius in meters to search for features (default: 0)

limit.description: Number of features to return (1-50, default: 5)

dedupe.description: Whether to deduplicate identical features (default: true)

layers.description: Specific layer names to query from the tileset

bands.description: Specific band names to query (for rasterarray tilesets)

tools.name: validate_expression_tool
tools.description: Validates Mapbox style expressions for syntax, operators, and argument correctness

expression.description: Mapbox expression to validate (JSON string or expression array)

context.description: Context where the expression will be used

tools.name: validate_geojson_tool
tools.description: Validates GeoJSON objects for correctness, checking structure, coordinates, and geometry types

geojson.description: GeoJSON object or JSON string to validate

tools.name: validate_style_tool
tools.description: Validates Mapbox style JSON against the Mapbox Style Specification, checking for errors, warnings, and providing suggestions for improvement

style.description: Mapbox style JSON object or JSON string to validate against the Mapbox Style Specification
